screens.name: Alerts Panel (Always-Visible Side Region)

transitions.note: Per C3/task-5: NEVER show blank panel. Show 'No active alerts -- system nominal'.
In Mock mode, this fires at t=90s from demo start per C3/LC-4. Alert is deterministic and fires exactly once.
Clicking an alert opens zone-detail for that alert's zone
Visual-only in MVP per task-5. Alert greys out, moves to bottom.
THE 90-SECOND TIMED ALERT. Fires exactly once per demo session. Severity=critical, zone=highest-density zone at that moment. Per C3: guaranteed wow moment for Dana. Re-armed on demo reset.
Same 90s timed alert, but panel already has items (e.g., info-level alerts fired earlier)
Per task-5 failure mode: broken zone references handled gracefully

timed_events.description: Pre-seeded critical alert fires exactly 90 seconds after demo session start (or after demo reset). Targets the highest-density zone. Fires once per session. Re-armed on reset.

feedback: skeleton (3 alert card placeholders with severity color bars)

screens.notes: Reset never reloads the page (AP-1/E1). In Mock/Replay, it is near-instant with undo window. In Live/Mesh, explicit confirmation required. Resets: heatmap to t=0, clears alerts, re-arms 90s timed alert, resets DemoSession.elapsed_s to 0. Mode badge remains unchanged.

global_transitions.note: R key is the universal reset shortcut per AP-1. Guarded against firing when typing in inputs.
